title: Lift a set-valued stalk equivalence to abelian group objects
statement: Let C be a category with objects in Type (u+1) and morphisms in Type u, J a Grothendieck topology, p a Type-u-valued point of J [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and G a topological group. Put w=max(u+1,v), D=Rep.DiscreteContinuousRep Z G [def-exc-discrete-modules-category], U its inclusion into Rep Z G, and V the inclusion of discrete continuous G-actions into all G-actions. Given an equivalence Eset:Sh(J,Type w) ≌ DiscreteContAction(Type w,G) and a natural isomorphism j from its underlying-set functor to the stalk p, there are an equivalence E:Sh(J,AddCommGrpCat w) ≌ D and an additive stalk comparison i. The underlying G-action functor of E is naturally isomorphic to forgetting the abelian sheaf and applying Eset. Moreover, for every abelian sheaf F, g in G, object X, pointed lifts x,x' in p(X), and section z in F(X), if j sends the g-translate of the set-valued germ of z at x to its germ at x', then i sends the g-translate of the abelian germ of z at x to its germ at x'.

proof.text: Apply [lem-exc-abelian-sheaves-gmodules-transport] to J, G and Eset. Obtain the equivalence E and the equivariant underlying-action comparison beta. This theorem contains no point or stalk comparison; the rest of the proof constructs those comparisons and their action compatibility.

Let H be the underlying abelian-group functor of E, and Q the forgetful functor on abelian sheaves. Let gamma:Q followed by the set-valued stalk -> additive stalk followed by forget be Point.sheafFiberCompIso. Whisker beta with the underlying-set functor for actions, then compose with Q whiskered with j and with gamma; obtain alpha:H followed by forget -> additive stalk followed by forget. The additive stalk preserves finite limits (Point.Basic and AddCommGrpCat.AB, with AB5OfSize_shrink to the point universe). Hence so does H followed by forget, by preservesFiniteLimits_of_natIso. The forgetful functor reflects finite limits, so preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves makes H left exact. These are direct Mathlib applications, not extra assumptions on E or beta.

The source category of abelian sheaves is preadditive and has finite products, hence finite biproducts (HasFiniteBiproducts.of_hasFiniteProducts). Apply [lem-exc-left-exact-functor-forget-equivalence] to this category. Both H and the additive stalk are left exact. Take preimageIso of alpha in this fully faithful forgetful functor and forget the left-exact-functor wrappers to obtain i. Functor.map_preimage gives forget(i)=alpha, on the nose. On every object F and element a this reads i_F(a)=gamma_F(j_QF(beta_F(a))).

Point.toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberCompIso_hom_app says gamma_F carries the set-valued germ of z at y to its additive germ, for y=x and y=x′. The comm equation for beta_F says beta_F(rho_E(g,a))=rho_set(g,beta_F(a)). To identify beta_F(i_F^{-1}(germ_x(z))), apply injectivity first of j_QF and then of gamma_F; the equation forget(i)=alpha and inverse-isomorphism cancellation identify it with j_QF^{-1}(set-germ_x(z)). Substitute this equality, equivariance of beta_F, and the supplied set-germ equality into the formula for i_F. Apply the germ comparison at x′. This proves exactly the additive action implication; there is no choice or nonemptiness hypothesis on z.
